I am Elise, lady to the Queen, servant all my life. They say I am mad with fever. But this is truth. Hear my final story, if you are able, if you care a whit, if you can know its significance.

I was barely more than a child myself when Simona was first let into the castle, a glowing vision of a girl dressed in a peasant's rags. Even then the head scullery maid ordered her hair be covered so she didn't attract 'attention'. In the end, it made no difference.

Simona was kind to me. This, I recall. I often helped the girl with her work as she braided the Queen's hair. After she was finished, Queen Astrid would beg her to stay, to tell stories. Simona had a way with stories. She never refused. And when King Alexander came to bed and woo Simona, who was she to refuse him, either?

Then there was the book. That horrid book... Simona brought it home. From where? Who gave it to her? I still don't know. Four days later, news of Queen Astrid's sudden death shocked the castle into mute horror, and Simona was quietly whisked away to the King's chambers. She was now the King's only lover. A low-born nobody with the power to rule nations.

The guards whispered of Queen Astrid's body: of how she died with her own nails lodged in her throat, the flesh torn, gone abruptly and thoroughly mad, her blood seeping through the keep tower's floor.

Simona came to me early one morning when it was still dark, inconsolably upset and without a light. "The book is cursed," She whispered to me in the darkness, her face wet with tears. "Elise, you don't understand. I was trapped in Elsinore for ever, for a thousand years or more. I saw every outcome I could, every possible version of this world, and it was all rotten. What could I do, Elise? What could I do? The book made me choose, and I chose to let Astrid rot with it all, so I could rule..."

She kissed me goodbye and pressed a coin into my hand. "I cannot hide from God," she said. "But I cannot stay in Elsinore. Tell no one where I went. Promise me, Elise."

And here I am, breaking that promise. I know Simona lives. What happened that insane week all those years ago? What will become of little Ophelia and Laertes, and my beloved husband I left behind? I will go to my grave not knowing.

Should my family ever read this, know this: I lived a far luckier life than any woman of my station ought to have enjoyed. But the luckiest thing in my world was always you.

我是伊莉丝，王后的侍女，一辈子都在服侍人。他们说我发烧烧疯了。但这些都是真的。请听听我最后的故事，只要你还能听，只要你还有一点在乎，只要你能明白它意味着什么。

西蒙娜初次获准进入城堡时，我自己也才刚过孩童的年纪。她穿着农家人的破衣烂衫，却美得光彩照人。那时，洗碗女仆的领班就命令她把头发遮起来，免得引来“注意”。到头来，这也没起什么作用。

西蒙娜待我很好。这一点，我记得。她为王后编头发时，我常常帮她做事。编完之后，阿斯特丽德王后总会央求她留下来讲故事。西蒙娜很会讲故事。她从不拒绝。而当亚历山大国王来向西蒙娜求欢、与她同床时，她又哪有资格拒绝他呢？

后来，那本书出现了。那本可怕的书……西蒙娜把它带回了家。从哪里来的？是谁给她的？我至今都不知道。四天后，阿斯特丽德王后猝死的消息让整个城堡陷入惊恐，鸦雀无声，而西蒙娜被悄悄带进了国王的寝宫。如今，她成了国王唯一的情人。一个出身卑微的无名之辈，却有了统治列国的权力。

卫兵们悄声议论着阿斯特丽德王后的尸体：她死时，自己的指甲还扎在喉咙里，皮肉被撕破；她突然彻底疯了，鲜血渗过了主堡塔楼的地板。

一天清晨，天还没亮，西蒙娜就来找我。她悲痛欲绝，也没带灯。“那本书受了诅咒，”她在黑暗中低声对我说，满脸都是泪。“伊莉丝，你不明白。我被永远困在埃尔西诺，困了一千年，甚至更久。我看遍了我能看到的每一种结局，这个世界每一种可能的模样，全都腐烂不堪。我能怎么办，伊莉丝？我能怎么办？那本书逼我选择，而我选择让阿斯特丽德和这一切一起腐烂，好让我掌权……”

她吻了我，向我道别，又把一枚钱币塞进我手里。“我躲不过上帝，”她说，“但我不能留在埃尔西诺。别告诉任何人我去了哪里。答应我，伊莉丝。”

而现在，我却在违背那个承诺。我知道西蒙娜还活着。多年前那个疯狂的星期里，究竟发生了什么？年幼的奥菲莉娅和雷欧提斯，还有我留下的心爱丈夫，往后会怎样？我到死都不会知道。

如果我的家人有一天读到这些，请记住：我这一生的幸运，远远超过了像我这样身份的女人所能奢望的。但在我的世界里，最幸运的事，始终是有你们。

Again... again... again... Polonius, not even you can save your master from Hell this time.

I concede defeat on ever finding that book. The Hand of Dionysus, they call it. I find references, mentions, breadcrumbs. Did you know it's been mentioned as far back as Judas Iscariot, and even older still? Polonius, find the book so that no one must suffer, must die like this.

Time is nothing. Death is nothing. For the last hundred years alone I have lain in the garden, awaiting the trickle of my brother's poison in my ear a thousand times. Again and again and again. How cruel should it be that this gap of time seems to begin and end with me lying in the garden on a warm spring morning? How does my brother always find a way to kill me? Is his hatred of me truly so strong? And my wife—my wife, her faithfulness useless, meaningless, the bridal bed soiled with another's lust...

Let her have him if she loves him so much. Let them cavort in the halls of Elsinore, and some year hence, the chambers of Hell. I could not say goodbye to my only son. My regrets burn in my throat like acid, like poison. I can say goodbye only to you.

So farewell, my faithful advisor. Bury me far from Claudius if it's the last thing you do. I can hear the playmaster's foosteps in the hallway, here to relieve me from this endless madness. I give up. I give up.

又一次……又一次……又一次……波洛涅斯，这一次，连你也救不了你的主人，让他免下地狱。

要找到那本书，我认输了。他们称它为“狄俄尼索斯之手”。我找到了一些记载、提及它的文字、零星的线索。你知道吗，早在加略人犹大的时代，就有人提到过它，甚至还要更早？波洛涅斯，找到那本书，让所有人都不必再这样受苦、这样死去。

时间算不了什么。死亡算不了什么。仅仅过去这一百年，我就已在花园里躺过一千次，等着弟弟的毒药滴进我的耳朵。一次又一次，一次又一次。这段时间竟以我在温暖的春日清晨躺在花园里为起点，又以此为终点，这该是何等残酷？为什么弟弟总能找到杀我的办法？他对我的恨，当真如此深吗？还有我的妻子——我的妻子，她的忠贞毫无用处，毫无意义，新婚的床榻被另一个人的欲望玷污……

她既然那么爱他，就让她得到他吧。让他们在埃尔西诺的厅堂里尽情嬉闹，再过些年，就去地狱的房间里继续。我没能向我唯一的儿子道别。悔恨灼烧着我的喉咙，像酸液，像毒药。我只能向你道别。

那么，永别了，我忠诚的顾问。哪怕这是你最后能做的一件事，也要把我葬在远离克劳狄斯的地方。我听见了戏剧大师在走廊里的脚步声，他来让我摆脱这无尽的疯狂了。我放弃了。我放弃了。

source: June 6, MDXXXV Ophelia will not even look at me. My love for her means nothing now. And in the great hall, they rejoice my uncle's crowning, my father's proud form but a distant memory. If my uncle does not allow me to return to Wittenberg soon, I fear I will well and truly perish. August 8 That thing was not my father. It can't be. My father lies buried. But if it wasn't my father... what devil or evil spirit was it? Am I truly losing my mind? Was it real? Can I be certain it wasn't just a horrid dream? No, the others saw it too... even if they won't speak to me of it. My uncle cannot be trusted. Devils disregarded, there is yet something evil in him. I found the literature which Bernardo mentioned, tucked away in the gallery downstairs... it only confirms my suspicions. And yet... something in me keeps me from acting on it. What has stolen my courage?
target: MDXXXV年6月6日 奥菲莉娅连看都不愿看我一眼。我对她的爱，如今已毫无意义。大厅里，他们欢庆着叔父加冕，父亲那威严的身影却已成了遥远的记忆。如果叔父不尽快准许我回威登堡，我怕自己真的会死去。 8月8日 那个东西不是我的父亲。不可能是。我的父亲已埋在地下。 但如果那不是父亲……那又是什么魔鬼或邪灵？我真的正在发疯吗？那是真的吗？我能确定那不只是一场可怕的梦吗？不，其他人也看见了……即使他们不愿和我谈起它。 叔父不可信。即便不去管那些魔鬼，他身上也仍有邪恶的东西。我找到了贝尔纳多提过的文字，藏在楼下的画廊里……它只是进一步证实了我的怀疑。然而……我心里有什么东西，让我迟迟无法据此采取行动。是什么夺走了我的勇气？

My glass shall not persuade me I am old
So long as youth and thou are one of date.
But when in thee time's furrows I behold,
Then look I death my days should expiate.
For all that beauty that doth cover thee
Is but the seemingly raiment of my heart
Which in thy breast doth live, as thine in mine.
How can I then be elder than thou art?
O therefore, love, be of thyself so wary
As I, not for myself, but for thee will,
Bearing thy heart, which I will keep so chary
As tender nurse her babe from faring ill.
Presume not on thy heart when mine is slain;
Thou gav'st me thine not to give back again.

镜子便休想劝我承认衰老。

如温柔的乳母护着婴孩，免遭伤害。
若我的心已死，莫以为你的心仍可安然；
你将它给了我，便不是要我再归还。

My Dearest Gertrude,

I hope this letter finds you in excellent health. Although I have not had the pleasure of your company in some years, I hope you will remember me fondly, Aunt, as I do you. I write to you with news of your sister, my most beloved Aunt Margaret.

Not one month ago, as one of her maids served a meal, the maid happened to drop a glass goblet, causing it to shatter. One of those shattered fragments entered Margaret's foot, and caused her to take gravely ill as the wound festered. Her physician recommended the limb be removed, and Margaret, then in good health, bade it be so. Yet on the very morning she was to undergo such a thing, she passed into the arms of God. You will be pleased to hear, I am certain, that the sacrament was administered in advance. May God rest her eternal soul.

I know that Margaret would have wanted you by her side in her final moments. Take comfort in the fact that she loved you dearly, and spoke of you often in her last few days.

Your faithful nephew,
Charles

我最亲爱的乔特鲁德：

愿您收到这封信时身体康健。虽然已有数年未能有幸与您相聚，我仍希望，姨母，您能像我思念您一样，怀着温情记起我。我写信是要告诉您关于您姐妹的消息，她也是我最亲爱的玛格丽特姨母。

不到一个月前，她的一名女仆在上菜时不慎掉落了一只玻璃高脚杯，杯子摔得粉碎。一块碎片扎进了玛格丽特的脚，伤口溃烂，使她病情危重。她的医生建议截去那条腿，玛格丽特当时身体状况尚好，便同意了。然而，就在她将接受截肢的那天清晨，她投入了上帝的怀抱。我相信，得知她已事先领受圣礼，您会感到欣慰。愿上帝赐她永恒的灵魂安息。

我知道，玛格丽特一定希望您在她最后的时刻陪伴在侧。她深爱着您，在最后几天里也时常提起您，愿这能给您些许安慰。

您忠实的外甥，
查尔斯

Have you often wondered at the true form and character of your lover? Pay careful mind: here are eight signs he's foe rather than friend! 

FIRST, within mere days of your acquaintance, he declares that if you 'call him but love, he'll be new baptis'd.' This nobleman is a walking source of dramatic show, clinging to any poor girl who crosses his path. Abnormally likely to meet his end in poison and tears.

SECOND, he uses the term 'taming' or 'shrew' in your presence—or even worse, in the same sentence. If he attempts to starve you to break your will, eat his heart out.

THIRD, he suddenly finds himself madly in love with your closest friend after promising you his undying heart. Keep a sharp eye out for faerie dust in the vicinity. 

FOURTH, he sticks a dagger in your back, then blames it on your 'ambition.' Don't worry: your restless spirit will have revenge. Stay indoors on March 15 if possible.

FIVE, after you help him murder his friends and cover up the crimes, he begins embarrassing you with inappropriate sobbing at your dinner parties. Even the most heartening prophecy can't revive this relationship. 

SIX, he tells you your wife has been unfaithful, but offers flimsy proof. Take a walk, enjoy some deep breathing, and stay away from pillows.

SEVEN, he tries to convince you to kill your brother. One might think this clear as day, yet this author is continually surprised.

EIGHT, sometimes he tells you to get to a nunnery. Other times he tells you he 'did love you once.' Which is it? Send this uncouth boy sulking back to university!

你是否常常琢磨，恋人的真面目和品性究竟如何？请留个心眼：下面八个征兆，说明他是敌人，而非朋友！ 

第一，才认识几天，他就宣称，只要你“叫他一声爱人，他便重新受洗”。这位贵族浑身都是戏，见到哪个可怜姑娘都要纠缠一番。他死于毒药与泪水的可能性高得离谱。

第二，他当着你的面说起“驯服”或“悍妇”——更糟的是，把这两个词用在同一句话里。他若想靠饿着你来磨掉你的意志，那就把他的心挖出来吃掉。

第三，刚向你许下永不变心的誓言，他就突然疯狂地爱上了你最亲密的朋友。留意一下附近有没有仙子的魔法粉。 

第四，他在你背后捅了一刀，却说都是你的“野心”惹的祸。别担心：你不得安息的亡魂自会报仇。三月十五日，能不出门就别出门。

第五，你帮他杀害朋友、掩盖罪行之后，他却在你的晚宴上哭哭啼啼，失态得让你难堪。再鼓舞人心的预言，也救不了这段关系。 

第六，他说你的妻子对你不忠，却拿不出像样的证据。出去散散步，做几个深呼吸，别碰枕头。

第七，他试图说服你杀死自己的兄弟。这迹象似乎再明显不过了，可笔者仍一再为此感到惊讶。

第八，他一会儿叫你进修道院，一会儿又说他“曾经确实爱过你”。到底哪句才算数？把这个没教养的小子赶回大学，让他自己生闷气去！

source: MARCH This morning I awoke from a vision of God as I slept. I saw Him before me in all His glory, and He spoke to me. When the dream faded, I realized my face was wet with tears. The Lord told me to enter the service of a certain Duke Iocus living in a town near here, and to oversee the man's baptism. This particular Duke was orphaned as a child, and as such, his holy education had been sorely neglected. I knew I had no choice but to obey God's will and to go seek out this man. That very dawn, I packed my things, paid the tab at my inn, and traveled over field and hill until I reached the gates of Duke Iocus's estate. Duke Iocus is a man of notorious reputation, to be certain; handsome, but wicked. Of course, as I have sworn a vow of modesty and chastity, I knew his wicked vices would have no influence on me. I knocked once and, hearing a shout, interpreted it as an invitation to enter. Imagine my surprise when I found the good Duke himself in the middle of beastly fornication with a young maiden... on the floor of the foyer, no less. The two of them were braying and sweating as nothing I'd ever seen. Flushing red, I coughed politely to make my presence known, but the Duke merely rolled over and lazily extended a hand in greeting. "Ahh, a cleric!" He boomed. "What brings you to my estate?" I introduced myself and declared my purpose to him, asking if he wished to be baptised. He roared with laughter. "What rubbish!" He explained to me that he had no need for a holy man, but all the need in the world for a stalwart butler... and so, before I could think of anything better, I agreed to serve him in that capacity. "I warn you, my new cleric butler," Iocus swore, "I shall never believe in any God you serve." He may say this now, but I believe I can change his heart. APRIL My lord Iocus has kept me busy this last month. One of my continual duties is to ensure the sanctity of his personal bedchamber, especially its cleanliness, so that he might continue to seduce all manner of impressionable young folk into it at all hours of the day and night. His lust seems to know no boundaries. I find it both frightening and some matter of clinical interest to me. Today, when tidying his chamber, I thought I might leave my bible at his bedside. Surely, I thought, he might read a page or two? I was right. He pushed into my room later that evening without knocking and handed the bible back to me. "What a fascinating book!" he declared. "Have you come to know God?" "Sort of. I read only the book called Song of Songs. I learned so many fascinating ways to compliment a woman's breasts. Never read anything so erotic in my life!" "And what of the rest of it, my liege?" He shrugged. "Dull. Dry. Lacking in action, heavy-handed on miracles to service the plot. Couldn't get through half of it without falling asleep." He spun on his heel and left. MAY For the last month, my lord Iocus kindly allowed me to bring a prayer group into his home. It is but once a week, on the sabbath. Tonight's subject was on preparing oneself to enter the communion of marriage and opening one's heart to God. Three young women and three young men came to our door, all of them in their finest clothing, ready to receive the Word. Ordinarily Iocus is prone to leaving home on nights like these to drink and play, but tonight he seemed compelled to linger. Not one hour in, after the wine had been served, Iocus came to me. "We've nothing to serve them to eat!" he fretted. "Nothing but bread and cheese. What sort of a meal is that? My good cleric, run into town and purchase an entire boar at once!" I donned my cloak, took a satchel of gold, and started off, giving the group my apologies. ...But three hours later, I returned to a scene which disturbed me to my core. Around the threshold of the front door were strewn half a dozen empty wineskins. Entering the foyer, I saw two of the young women giggling and chasing after the lads—all of them naked as babes and red in the face. From upstairs, I could faintly hear the sound of distant moans. "My Duke!" I called out. "What manner of sin is going on in this home?" Six voices rang out in muffled, sensual laughter. "What manner, indeed. I can be as specific as you like!" Duke Iocus called back, the seventh voice, barely stifling his own laugh. "Though we're, ah, preoccupied. Friends, make room in the bath—I'm coming in!" I think I must have gone into a dead faint, then. I knelt on the floor and prayed with all my might. Later that night, Iocus burst into my chambers. His hair was wild, his eyes rolling. He was stark naked. "Praise God!" He shouted. "I beg your pardon?" I said, bleary and half-awake. "My dear cleric, I've seen the light! I want you to baptise me immediately. Tomorrow at dawn, if possible!" "My lord," I said in shock, "What changed your mind?" Iocus shook his head. "I was nestled in a pile of limbs and lovemaking for hours. I thought for a moment I might die entwined like that. And I did experience a death, of sorts. But then, at the moment of release, a sense of utter peace came over me, the manner of which I can hardly describe. I've never felt so content! So magical! So right! I remembered all your endlessly dull lectures about the Holy Spirit. And I knew then that surely this must be your God's way of speaking through me. This must be how you feel every day!" I stared for a moment in horror. Neither of us spoke. "...So you'll be baptised?" I ventured after a long silence. "Right away, my good man. I want to be a Christian!" "Fair enough," I said, and went back to sleep. The Lord works in mysterious ways.
target: 三月 今晨，我从梦中上帝显现的异象里醒来。我看见祂在我面前，满身荣光，向我说话。梦境消散时，我才发现自己满脸泪水。主吩咐我去侍奉住在附近镇上的一位约库斯公爵，并负责为他施洗。这位公爵幼年便成了孤儿，因此，他的宗教教育被严重忽视了。我知道，我别无选择，唯有遵从上帝的旨意，去寻找此人。 就在那天黎明，我收拾好行李，结清旅店的账，穿过田野与山丘，直到来到约库斯公爵庄园的大门前。约库斯公爵确实声名狼藉；他相貌英俊，却品行邪恶。当然，我既已立下谦逊与贞洁的誓言，便知道他的邪恶恶习不会影响我。 我敲了一下门，听见一声喊叫，便当作是请我进去。想想我有多么吃惊吧：那位好公爵本人，竟正与一位年轻姑娘如野兽般交媾……而且就在门厅的地板上。两人嘶叫着，汗流浃背，那情形我从未见过。我满脸通红，礼貌地咳了一声，示意有人来了；公爵却只是翻了个身，懒洋洋地伸出一只手打招呼。“啊，一位教士！”他洪亮地说道，“什么风把你吹到我的庄园来了？” 我自报姓名，向他说明来意，问他是否愿意接受洗礼。他放声大笑。“一派胡言！”他向我解释，他不需要什么圣职人员，却急需一位尽职可靠的管家……于是，还没想到更好的办法，我就答应以管家的身份侍奉他。“我警告你，我的新教士管家，”约库斯郑重说道，“不管你侍奉什么上帝，我都绝不会信。” 他眼下或许这样说，但我相信，我能改变他的心意。 四月 过去这一个月，约库斯老爷让我忙得不可开交。我日常职责之一，就是确保他的私人寝室圣洁，尤其要保持干净，好让他日夜随时都能把各种容易受人影响的年轻人诱进房里。他的淫欲似乎毫无边界。我既觉得可怕，又从研究的角度对此有些兴趣。 今天收拾他的寝室时，我想，或许可以把我的《圣经》留在他床边。我心想，他总该会读上一两页吧？ 我猜对了。当天晚上，他没敲门便闯进我的房间，把《圣经》还给我。“真是本引人入胜的书！”他宣称。 “您已经认识上帝了吗？” “算是吧。我只读了那篇叫《雅歌》的。我学会了好多赞美女人胸脯的妙法。这辈子都没读过这么香艳的东西！” “那么其余的部分呢，老爷？” 他耸耸肩。“无聊。枯燥。没什么情节，倒是硬塞了不少奇迹来推动故事。还没读到一半就睡着了。”他转身便走。 五月 过去一个月，约库斯老爷好心允许我在他家中组织祈祷聚会。每周只有一次，就在安息日。今晚的主题是为步入婚姻的结合做好准备，并向上帝敞开心扉。三位年轻女子和三位年轻男子来到门前，个个都穿着自己最好的衣服，准备聆听圣言。通常这种晚上，约库斯总爱出门喝酒玩乐，可今晚他似乎忍不住要留下。 还不到一个小时，葡萄酒已经端上，约库斯便来找我。“我们没东西给他们吃！”他焦急地说，“只有面包和奶酪。这算哪门子饭？我的好教士，快进镇里去，立刻买一整头野猪回来！”我披上斗篷，带上一袋金币，向众人致歉后便出发了。 ……可三小时后，我回来所见的情景，却令我从心底感到不安。前门门槛四周，散落着六只空酒囊。走进门厅，我看见两位年轻女子咯咯笑着追逐那些小伙子——所有人都像初生婴儿一般赤裸，脸色通红。楼上传来隐约的呻吟声。 “公爵大人！”我喊道，“这屋里究竟在犯什么罪？”六个人发出低低的、充满情欲的笑声。 “究竟什么罪，这可问得好。你想听多详细，我都能说！”约库斯公爵回喊道，这是第七个人的声音，他自己也快憋不住笑了。“不过我们，啊，正忙着。朋友们，在浴池里腾个地方——我也来！” 我想，那时我一定已经昏厥过去了。我跪在地板上，用尽全力祈祷。 那天深夜，约库斯闯进我的寝室。他头发凌乱，眼珠乱转，全身赤裸。“赞美上帝！”他喊道。 “您说什么？”我睡眼惺忪，半梦半醒地问。 “亲爱的教士，我已看见了光！我要你立刻为我施洗。可以的话，就在明天黎明！” “老爷，”我惊愕地说，“是什么让您改变了心意？” 约库斯摇摇头。“我在交缠的肢体间温存了好几个小时。有那么一刻，我以为自己会就这样缠绕着死去。而我确实经历了一次死亡，某种意义上的。可就在释放的那一刻，一种无比安宁的感觉笼罩了我，我简直无法形容。我从没这么满足过！这么神奇！这么美好！我想起你那些关于圣灵的、没完没了的乏味说教。那时我便知道，这一定是你的上帝借我的身体传达旨意的方式。你每天一定都是这种感觉！” 我惊恐地瞪着他，一时无言。我们谁也没说话。沉默许久后，我试探着问：“……这么说，您愿意接受洗礼？” “立刻就来，我的好伙计。我要做个基督徒！” “那好吧。”我说完，便接着睡了。 主行事自有奥秘。

Hear me, young maidens who have traveled wild,
Whose eyes have never seen the touch of death,
Who tarry often when the sun grows dim,
Who linger long by cairns and caverns dark.

I once was you in spirit and in heart.
I am Persephone, the taken one.
When I was young I planted seeds alone,
And gathered flowers freely in the sun.

One day the earth burst forth with violent seams
And ashes belched with spite upon the land.
King Hades, Lord of Death, had come for me,
To seize and make me his unwilling bride.

At first I cried out to the world above,
But no one heard the call to grab my hand.
He pulled me down into the low beyond,
And I knew this was where I'd make my grave.

No flowers grew within the world of death.
I fell upon the ground and wept with fear.
As Hades offered me his outstretched hand,
I flinched from him and clenched my trembling fists.

He bade me then to take his hand's contents,
A small red fruit with tiny ruby seeds.
The god of many names, his countenance kind,
Pressed each small icy seed into my palm.

'Persephone, I'll never do you harm.
For years I've loved and watched you from afar.
Become my wife and you shall be the queen
Of everything that lives and moves about.

But if you wish to flee from me right now,
I'll trouble you no more and leave you be.
I brought you down here not to be your jailer,
But to show you the lands you might yet rule.'

Three days and nights I spent in Hades' world.
I grew to know his kingdom as my own.
When that third night fell on the river Styx,
I knew that I had made my final choice.

'I shall take these three seeds and be your bride,
If only you will grant me one small thing.
I wish to plant these seeds in darkness here,
And turn your endless winter into spring.'

So maidens, when you find you are now crones,
And when your kindest days all seem long past,
When winter sinks into your tired bones,
Prepare yourself to meet me then at last.

I'll guide you down the long unending halls
And bear you gently to the low beyond,
Where you will dine beside the ones you've lost
And join us in an everlasting bond.
target:
听我说，游历荒野的少女们，
你们的双眼尚未见过死亡，
常在日光渐暗时迟迟不归，
久久徘徊于石冢与幽暗洞穴旁。

我的心与灵魂也曾和你们一样。
我是珀耳塞福涅，被掳走的女子。
年轻时，我独自播下种子，
在阳光下自在地采集鲜花。

有一天，大地猛然裂开，
灰烬恶狠狠地喷涌，洒落大地。
冥王哈迪斯，死亡之主，为我而来，
要将我夺去，强娶为妻。

起初，我向地上的世界呼喊，
却无人听见，无人伸手拉住我。
他把我拉入地下的彼岸，
我知道，这里将是我的墓地。

死亡的世界里没有鲜花生长。
我倒在地上，恐惧地哭泣。
哈迪斯向我伸出手时，
我畏缩着躲开，攥紧颤抖的双拳。

随后，他让我接过掌中之物，
一颗红色的小果实，籽如细小的红宝石。
这位有着诸多名号的神，面容和善，
把一粒粒冰凉的种子放进我掌心。

“珀耳塞福涅，我绝不会伤害你。
多年来，我一直爱着你，从远处望着你。
做我的妻子，你便会成为女王，
统领一切活着、行走着的生灵。

但若你现在就想离我而去，
我便不再纠缠，任你离开。
我带你下来，并非要做你的狱卒，
而是让你看看将来或可统治的土地。”

我在哈迪斯的世界度过三天三夜。
渐渐熟悉他的王国，仿佛那是我的家园。
当第三个夜晚降临冥河斯堤克斯，
我知道，我已作出最后的选择。

“我愿收下这三粒种子，成为你的新娘，
只求你答应我一件小事。
我想把这些种子种在此处的黑暗里，
将你无尽的寒冬化作春天。”

所以，少女们，当你们也成了老妇，
当最美好的日子都仿佛远去，
当寒冬渗入你们疲惫的骨头，
就准备好，终于来与我相见吧。

我会引你们走过漫长无尽的厅堂，
轻柔地将你们带往地下彼岸，
在那里，你们将与逝去的亲人朋友同席，
与我们结下永恒的羁绊。

The Queen is one of the kindest people I've ever met, and her people love her dearly. Gertrude isn't Danish, but married into the throne via her late husband, the King Hamlet. As is traditional, she remarried to the King's brother after his death—now she is Claudius's wife.

After my mother passed away when I was a child, Gertrude took Laertes and me under her wing. I've been eternally grateful to her for her kindness ever since.

Gertrude was born in Austria, and is a member of the illustrious Hapsburg family. In fact, her father is the Emperor Maximilian I. She's worked incredibly hard to learn Danish and eliminate her accent. I know she has a sister as well, who lives outside Denmark. Royal blood runs thick through her veins.
target:
王后是我见过最善良的人之一，她的子民都十分爱戴她。乔特鲁德不是丹麦人，而是嫁给已故的哈姆雷特国王后成为了王后。国王去世后，她依照传统改嫁给他的弟弟——如今，她是克劳狄斯的妻子。

我小时候母亲去世后，乔特鲁德便照顾起了雷欧提斯和我。从那以后，我一直感激她的善意。

乔特鲁德出生于奥地利，是显赫的哈布斯堡家族的一员。事实上，她的父亲就是马克西米连一世皇帝。为了学会丹麦语、消除口音，她付出了极大的努力。我知道她还有一个姐妹，住在丹麦以外。她的血脉里流淌着深厚的皇室血统。

source: Polonius is my father, and the King's advisor. He can be a bit addle-brained at times, and he loves to talk—a lot—but he really just likes being around people, I think. He always means well. And he's been an attentive father to my brother Laertes and me... sometimes a little too attentive. It can be stifling.
target: 波洛涅斯是我的父亲，也是国王的顾问。他有时有点糊涂，而且特别爱说话——话多得很——不过，我想他其实只是喜欢和人待在一起。他总是出于好意。 他也一直很关心我哥哥雷欧提斯和我……有时候关心得有点过头了。让人喘不过气。

Irma is one of the most feared women in Elsinore for her quick temper. She's fiercely devoted to the Queen, and originally followed Gertrude from Bohemia, where she and Gertrude were both born and raised.

source: Irma's desire to discipline Hamlet ultimately degraded into a poisoning attempt which took the lives of the King, Queen, and herself. The people I love are capable of such horrors. source: I agreed to visit Claudius in his private chambers. And at the end of the night, he made it clear—in no uncertain terms—that he desired to be with me. target: 我答应去克劳狄斯的寝室看他。那晚临别时，他说得再清楚不过：他想和我在一起。我从小就认识他。除了哈姆雷特的叔叔，我很难把他看作别的什么人。但他的提议也隐约暗示了，得到国王的爱能带来怎样的财富。

source: Hamlet's madness was brought on not by love, but by a meeting with what he believes to be the spirit of his father. It's from there he must have gotten his information about Claudius's murder. But the information turned out to be correct - so does this spirit actually exist?

She's braver than I am. It's something I'd always wondered when Hamlet and I first began our courtship. Was he in love with me? Or simply the idea of a perpetual outsider who could never truly have the power to force him to behave?
target: 我们一起在船上的时候，吉尔登斯吞和哈姆雷特起了冲突。整件事至今仍让我难以理清，但她向哈姆雷特指出，他一直在追求那些在他眼中带着异域色彩的“异类”女性。像吉尔登斯吞这样的女人。像我这样的女人。她比我勇敢。哈姆雷特和我刚开始交往时，我就一直有这样的疑问。他爱的是我吗？还是仅仅迷恋这样一种想象：一个永远的局外人，永远不可能真正有能力约束他的行为？

source: All the love and hate I feel for them has vanished, to be replaced with... nothing.
target: 我对他们所有的爱与恨都已消失，取而代之的是……一片空白。

source: Today, I am going to a lovely party.
target: 今天，我要去参加一场美好的宴会。

source: Father will, tonight, tell Laertes all he once knew of love: How to be kind. How to disagree charitably. How to grow together.
target: 今晚，父亲会把自己曾经懂得的关于爱的一切都告诉雷欧提斯：如何善待对方。如何在意见不合时仍宽容相待。如何一起成长。

source: Besides—tonight, I am going to a lovely party.
target: 再说——今晚，我要去参加一场美好的宴会。

source: He talks about the love they felt for one another, and the love he feels for us.
target: 他谈起他们曾经对彼此的爱，也谈起他对我们的爱。

source: I have never felt so loved, or so wanted. His eyes are the last thing I see before I fall asleep that night, his arms wrapped tightly around me.
target: 我从未感觉自己如此被爱、如此被渴望。那晚入睡前，我最后看到的是他的眼睛，他的双臂紧紧环抱着我。

source: 'I was once a popular man in Venice, believe it or not. Don't live in squalor. Let your friends help you. Love, H.'
target: “信不信由你，我从前在威尼斯还挺受欢迎的。别过得那么窘迫。让朋友们帮帮你吧。爱你的，霍。”

source: He loves her more each day, and me less.
target: 他一天比一天更爱她，也一天比一天更不爱我。

source: I even grow to love it sometimes, in the quiet moments.
target: 有时，在那些安静的时刻，我甚至渐渐爱上了这样的生活。

source: For years I loved a man who loved me more than life itself. A love to surpass the stars. A love which outshone even Desdemona.
target: 那些年，我爱着一个爱我胜过生命的男人。那份爱超越星辰。那份爱甚至让苔丝狄蒙娜也黯然失色。

source: I will never forget that love. But it's time for me to move on. And I do.
target: 我永远不会忘记那份爱。但我该继续往前走了。而我也做到了。

source: I love my brother more than anyone in this world. I tell myself that his life is enough. I tell myself I had no other choice.
target: 在这个世上，我最爱的人就是哥哥。我告诉自己，只要他活着就够了。我告诉自己，我别无选择。

source: They stare at me with cold eyes. They have no great love for this union. To them, it is a transaction to ensure the Danish crown remains intact.
target: 他们冷眼盯着我。他们并不喜欢这桩婚事。在他们看来，这是一场确保丹麦王权稳固的交易。

source: That this life is suffering from start to finish, punctuated by fleeting moments of bliss. Love merely stops the bleeding a while.
target: 她说，人生从头到尾都是苦难，幸福只是转瞬即逝的点缀。爱，也只能暂时缓解这些苦痛。

source: Slowly, the manor-home comes together. It regains its former loveliness.
target: 慢慢地，庄园里的宅邸修整好了，恢复了往日的美丽。

source: I meander wherever my wants take me. I drink and I love whenever and whomever I please.
target: 我随心所欲地四处闲逛。想什么时候喝酒就什么时候喝，想什么时候爱、爱谁，都由我自己决定。

source: And... I love it. I get to know Guildenstern better than I ever did in Elsinore. And I see Rosencrantz through new eyes, too.
target: 而且……我很喜欢这样的日子。我对吉尔登斯吞的了解，比在埃尔西诺时深得多。我也开始用全新的眼光看待罗森克兰兹。

source: Prince Ferdinand, as it turns out, came to Elsinore to support his brother in the unification effort. I don't want to love another politician, so I guard my heart against him.
target: 原来，费迪南德王子来埃尔西诺，是为了协助他的兄弟推进统一。我不想再爱上一个从政的人，所以不让自己对他动心。

source: By the time the flowers are blooming, Ferdinand and I marry in the grounds we love so dearly. Neither of us was ever much for the church. Some find it scandalous. We don't mind.
target: 鲜花盛开时，费迪南德和我在我们钟爱的庭园里成婚。我们两人向来都不怎么热衷于教会。有些人觉得这有违礼俗。我们并不在意。

source: Be careful, love. That's all I ask. Carrying on like this--it terrifies me. I don't want you hurt.
target: 要小心，亲爱的。我只求你这一点。你一直这样下去——我真的很害怕。我不想你受伤。

source: I thought I had identified the cause. I thought he was merely lovesick.
target: 我以为自己已经找到了原因。我以为他只是害了相思病。

source: Hamlet is lovesick. He's a man obsessed. And he's after my daughter.
target: 哈姆雷特害了相思病。他已经着了魔。他正在追求我的女儿。

source: Now, now. None of that talk here, love.
target: 好了，好了。亲爱的，这些话就别在这里说了。

source: There may be more to this than mere lovesickness.
target: 这件事可能不只是相思病那么简单。

source: And I do so love a guest writer. What have you brought me?
target: 而且我特别喜欢有人客串编剧。您给我带来了什么？

source: Isn't that right, my love?
target: 是吧，亲爱的？

source: Honest as always, and ever so naïve! I loved you once for those very qualities.
target: 还是那么诚实，也还是那么天真！我曾经爱你，正是因为这些。

source: You were a fool if you truly believed me. Ophelia, I never loved you.
target: 如果你真的信了我，那你就是个傻瓜。奥菲莉娅，我从来没爱过你。

source: I don't think we've seen this one before, have we, my love?
target: 我想我们以前没看过这出戏吧，亲爱的？

source: My King, let us count a thousand journeys of the sun and moon again before our love be done!
target: 我的国王，愿日月再轮转千回，你我之爱才到尽头！

source: Oh, my love. I must leave you soon. My form is weak, and frail. And thou shalt live in this fair world behind.
target: 啊，我的爱人。我很快就要离你而去。我这身躯虚弱不堪。而你将独留在这美好的世间。

source: Oh, confound the rest! Loving anyone else would be treason in my breast.
target: 啊，让其他人都见鬼去吧！若爱上别人，便是背叛了我的心。

source: The only women who can love a second husband must surely have killed the first!
target: 能爱上第二任丈夫的女人，必定亲手杀了第一任！

source: My love, my King, please awaken from your slumber and hold me—
target: 我的爱人，我的国王，请从沉睡中醒来，拥我入怀——

source: My love? Why are your lips so pale? And your cheeks so white?
target: 我的爱人？你的嘴唇为何如此苍白？脸颊为何毫无血色？

source: I protest! I'll never love you!
target: 我不答应！我永远不会爱你！

source: How can I ever love another after Gonzago?
target: 爱过贡扎古之后，我怎能再爱上别人？

source: We must tell no one. Not a single whisper, my love.
target: 我们不能告诉任何人。一个字都不能泄露，我的爱人。

source: Then he'll know that my love for you burns brighter than anything in this world—and that I am unafraid.
target: 那他就会知道，我对你的爱比世间一切都燃烧得更耀眼——而我无所畏惧。

source: When the Queen's own son leaves for faraway lands, she even makes love to her brother-in-law on her son's bed, knowing the door is locked tight!
target: 王后的亲生儿子远赴他乡后，她知道房门锁得严严实实，竟在儿子的床上与丈夫的兄弟欢爱！

source: Both men have been in my body... their flesh is my flesh, their lust is my love...!
target: 两个男人都曾进入我的身体……他们的肉体就是我的肉体，他们的欲望就是我的爱……！

source: If it wasn't for this sad excuse for a prince, my love would still be alive.
target: 要不是这个不配当王子的废物，我的爱人就还活着。

source: My love. Come here. Let me dry your tears.
target: 亲爱的。过来。让我擦干你的眼泪。

source: My lord, I love you with all my heart.
target: 陛下，我全心全意地爱着您。

source: Even now, this traitorous woman claims to love her King, yet plots to slit his throat...
target: 即便此刻，这个叛逆的女人仍声称爱着她的国王，心中却谋划着割断他的喉咙……

source: I love my King, but my country hates him so.
target: 我爱我的国王，可我的国家如此憎恨他。

source: What ails you, my lord, my love?
target: 陛下，我的爱人，什么事让您如此苦恼？

source: S-something about an endless day, my love? It's confusing to me, as well.
target: 是、是说一个永远过不完的日子吧，亲爱的？我也看得糊涂。

source: I have no idea what you're talking about. My love, please, why are you shouting at me?
target: 我根本不知道你在说什么。亲爱的，求你了，你为什么冲我大喊大叫？

source: Leave it to me. Hamlet was one of my oldest, most beloved friends. I will clean what remains.
target: 交给我吧。哈姆雷特是我相识最久、最珍爱的朋友之一。我会收拾好这里。

source: I love you with all my heart. Please don't let it come to this.
target: 我全心全意地爱你。求你，别走到这一步。

source: Nothing on this earth matters anymore. All good and beloved things are dust.
target: 这世上已经没有什么重要了。一切美好、珍爱的事物都已化为尘土。

source: One where the people I loved are still alive.
target: 在那里，我爱的人都还活着。

source: Bon voyage, beloveds. Take care.
target: 亲爱的，祝你们一路顺风。多保重。

source: We share a brotherly bond in some ways. We've fought like siblings. And I'm... I miss your father. I loved him, though I was poor at showing it.
target: 从某些方面来说，我们之间有兄弟般的情谊。我们也像兄弟一样争吵。而我……我想念你的父亲。我对他感情很深，只是不善于表达。

source: Ahh. Cool wine on a summer day. Something wrong, my love?
target: 啊。夏日里的一杯凉酒。怎么了，亲爱的？

source: My love, a-are you—look at me—are you all right?
target: 亲爱的，你、你——看着我——你还好吗？

source: You've stolen everything I've ever loved in this life. You've robbed me of my ability to feel joy, to want anything good.
target: 你夺走了我这一生所爱的一切。你让我再也无法感受快乐，无法渴望任何美好的事物。

source: I know. I love you, Laertes.
target: 我知道。我爱你，雷欧提斯。

source: Don't you dare. If you ever loved me, Horatio, as I do you...
target: 不许你这么做。霍拉旭，如果你曾在乎过我，像我在乎你一样……

source: My lady, you are his wife. As I understand it, you are beloved by your people. Can you speak no sense to him?
target: 王后，您是他的妻子。据我所知，您深受人民爱戴。您就不能劝他明白事理吗？

source: It is written upon your face that you loved him a great deal.
target: 你的脸上写得很清楚，你深爱着他。

source: Not for any lack of love We bear him—but because he is old, he wanders the halls recognizing no one, and his body is feeble.
target: 这并非因为我们不爱他——而是因为他老了，在厅廊间游荡，谁也认不出，身体也很虚弱。

source: But I loved Hamlet. And I would proudly put my hands around your neck if I thought it would stop further bloodshed.
target: 可我爱哈姆雷特。如果我认为扼住你的脖子就能阻止更多流血，我会骄傲地这么做。

source: Hamlet, you're making no sense, my love. Please, stop!
target: 哈姆雷特，亲爱的，你说的话毫无道理。求你别说了！

source: My lady, we shall all reunite with our departed loved souls in Heaven above. Until then, we shall pray for the boy he was.
target: 王后，我们终将在天国与逝去的挚爱重逢。在那之前，让我们为曾经的那个男孩祈祷。

source: Hamlet, my love, my husband.
target: 哈姆雷特，我的爱人，我的丈夫。

source: And if there's even the faintest chance... you told me you loved me, once.
target: 如果还有哪怕一丝机会……你曾经说过，你爱我。

source: Does it matter? I am powerless to choose to love you, even if I could.
target: 这重要吗？就算我还能爱你，我也没有权力选择去爱你。

source: Love, not so prickly. Calm yourself, please.
target: 亲爱的，别这么咄咄逼人。请冷静些。

source: My love, you must be tender with him.
target: 亲爱的，你得对他温柔些。

source: Some noble hearts cannot be beaten into obedience. But love them well, and they will love back, ever faithful.
target: 有些高贵的心，靠打是打不服的。但只要真心关爱他们，他们也会回以真情，始终忠诚。

source: I do so love strolling out in the utter darkness at midnight, alone. Don't you?
target: 我可喜欢在午夜独自出来，在一片漆黑中散步了。你们呢？

source: Such a lovely painting. I wonder what your story is?
target: 真是一幅美丽的画。不知道你有怎样的故事？

source: Things will be better on the other side, my love.
target: 到了那边就会好起来的，亲爱的。

source: Lovers' spats can turn violent so quickly, after all.
target: 毕竟，情侣拌嘴，转眼就可能动起手来。

source: I'm the laughingstock of everyone I've ever known and loved. Even my closest friends have turned on me.
target: 所有我认识过、爱过的人都把我当成笑柄。连最亲近的朋友也背叛了我。

source: Of course. Always, love.
target: 当然。一直都会，亲爱的。

source: Of course, love. You have my word. You always do.
target: 当然，亲爱的。我向你保证。一向如此。

source: He watches her like a lovesick fool. The King believes it's what's driven him mad.
target: 他像个害相思病的傻瓜一样盯着她。国王认为，这就是他发疯的原因。

source: And in the best case scenario, the lovesick idiot might ask her to marry him, and she might consent.
target: 而最好的情况下，那个害相思病的蠢货可能会向她求婚，她可能会答应。

source: Young Laertes here is deeply in love with Lady Birgitta. Who, as we all know, is a mite above his station.
target: 咱们这位小雷欧提斯，深深爱着布莉吉塔女士。大家都知道，她的身份比他高了那么一点。

source: You and I both know this is the last thing we desired. And I've no intention of trying to court you, or turn your disgust to love.
target: 你我都知道，这是我们最不想要的结果。我也无意向你求爱，或让你对我的厌恶变成爱。

source: I was not in love with Hamlet's father when I met him. I found him to be cold. Distant. Frightening. But I soon came to love him all the same.
target: 初见哈姆雷特的父亲时，我并不爱他。我觉得他冷漠。疏远。令人害怕。但尽管如此，我很快还是爱上了他。

source: This is the best possible thing for you and for Denmark. Some day you will understand I do this not to cause you pain, but out of love.
target: 对你和丹麦而言，这是最好的安排。总有一天你会明白，我这么做不是为了让你痛苦，而是出于爱。

source: I was not in love with your father when I met him. I found him to be cold. Distant. Frightening. But I soon came to love him all the same.
target: 初见你的父亲时，我并不爱他。我觉得他冷漠。疏远。令人害怕。但尽管如此，我很快还是爱上了他。

source: Time can turn even the most unwilling heart to softness. Time will grow a boy into a man, or a girl into a loving wife.
target: 时间能让再不情愿的心也变得柔软。时间会让男孩长成男人，让女孩成为满怀爱意的妻子。

source: Y'don't even love her.
target: 你根本就不爱她。

source: You think I don't know you love her?
target: 你以为我不知道你爱她？

source: Come here, love.
target: 过来，亲爱的。

source: Me? Harm your sister? Of course not, love. Just frightened her a little by accident.
target: 我？伤害你妹妹？当然没有，亲爱的。只是无意中稍微吓着她了。

source: And with all these vile men dead and gone, you and I would linger to love in peace.
target: 等这些卑劣的男人都死了，你我就能留下来，安安稳稳地相爱。

source: I'm going to be Queen of Denmark. And you shall be my King Consort. No one will ever put a stop to me loving you again.
target: 我将成为丹麦女王。而你会成为我的王夫。再也没有人能阻止我爱你。

source: There's no need to fear any longer, my love.
target: 不用再害怕了，亲爱的。

source: Will you tell her I love her, now and forever?
target: 能告诉她，我爱她，现在爱她，永远都爱她吗？

source: No! No, I wasn't! Listen, Laertes: I love you.
target: 不！不，我没有！听我说，雷欧提斯：我爱你。

source: And with all these vile men dead and gone, you and I would remain to love in peace.
target: 等这些卑鄙的男人全都死去，你和我就能留下来，平静地相爱。

source: It may not make sense now, or ever, but I'm sorry I deceived you. Everything I felt for you was honest. I love you more than anyone in the world.
target: 这些话现在也许说不通，或许永远都说不通，但我很抱歉欺骗了你。我对你的一切感情都是真的。我爱你胜过世上任何人。

source: My notes—my notes, taken by him, out of love, out of protection—
target: 我的笔记——我的笔记，他拿走了，出于关切，出于保护——

source: I had no choice. I had no choice, Hamlet, my love. I swear it.
target: 我别无选择。我别无选择，哈姆雷特，我的爱人。我发誓。

source: Father, you know how deeply I love you, right?
target: 父亲，你知道我有多爱你，对吧？

source: I understand that you love me, too.
target: 我也明白，你同样爱着我。

source: We both knew when we fell in love that it would end like this. It could be no other way.
target: 我们相爱时，就都知道会是这样的结局。不可能有别的结果。

source: I do so love this gallery. King Claudius may be a buffoon, but King Hamlet loved the great dramas and tragedies.
target: 我实在喜欢这间长廊。克劳狄斯国王或许是个丑角，但哈姆雷特国王很喜爱那些伟大的戏剧与悲剧。

source: Here. Ovid's 'Pyramus et Thisbe', the greatest love story ever written—for now, of course, until some half-rate bard steals and replicates it!
target: 看这里。奥维德的《皮拉摩斯与提斯柏》，有史以来最伟大的爱情故事——当然，目前是，直到某个二流诗人把它偷去再写一遍！

source: Two young lovers, so deeply fallen into one another that they'd rather die gruesomely than live apart.
target: 两个年轻恋人，爱彼此爱得那么深，宁愿惨死，也不愿分开活着。

source: But their love was brief, her pregnancy was a secret, and they were unwed. After I was born, my father absconded with me to Venice to save her reputation.
target: 但他们的爱情很短暂，她怀孕的事也瞒着别人，而且他们没有结婚。我出生后，为了保全她的名声，父亲带着我悄悄去了威尼斯。

source: But my father loved me dearly.
target: 但父亲非常疼爱我。

source: Margaret was everything to me when we were young. I loved her more than life itself.
target: 小时候，玛格丽特就是我的一切。我爱她胜过自己的生命。

source: But it was always to encourage me to cease contact, to study more, to love my new country and forget Austria entirely.
target: 但她总是劝我别再联系她，多用功学习，爱我的新国家，把奥地利彻底忘掉。

source: It is no matter. All the love I had for Margaret, I have poured into my husband and son. I hope they have appreciated it.
target: 没关系。我把对玛格丽特的爱，全都倾注到了丈夫和儿子身上。希望他们领会了这份心意。

source: Irma, lovely lovely lovely Irma!
target: 伊尔玛，亲爱的、亲爱的、亲爱的伊尔玛！

source: My lady is distressed, Lord Hamlet. She wants to make amends. I have loved her since she was a child.
target: 哈姆雷特殿下，王后很难过。她想弥补。我从她还是个孩子时起，就一直疼爱着她。

source: —Or any love deep in the fog of your madness!
target: ——或者在您那疯狂的迷雾深处，还剩半点爱！

source: Certainly no love, either.
target: 爱当然也没有。

source: But she loves him more than anything in the world.
target: 可她爱他，胜过世上的一切。

source: I love you. I loved you, Mother. I'm sorry. So very, horribly sorry.
target: 我爱你。我一直爱着你，母亲。对不起。我真的、真的对不起你，愧疚得无以复加。

source: All my lady ever did was try to love you with all of her soul.
target: 王后从始至终都只是想全心全意地疼爱你。

source: But you are not worthy of that love.
target: 可你不配得到这份爱。

source: Of course, love.
target: 那当然，亲爱的。

source: That's the strange thing about motherhood, darling. You may despise me more than anything in the world, but I will love you ever still.
target: 亲爱的，做母亲就是这么奇怪。你可以把我当成世上最厌恶的人，可我还是会永远爱你。

source: No amount of anger or rejected dinners can take that love from me.
target: 无论你发多少脾气，拒绝吃多少顿晚餐，都夺不走我对你的爱。

source: For what little made him good, Claudius loved my mother a great deal.
target: 克劳狄斯的好处虽少，但他确实深爱着我的母亲。

source: It's what my father would have wanted—the right thing for Denmark. The county you and I both love.
target: 这才是我父亲会希望看到的——为丹麦做正确的事。为了这个你我都深爱的国家。

source: Don't weep, my love. I have heard your prayers and whispers. I was with you in your loneliest moments.
target: 别哭，我的爱人。我听见了你的祈祷和低语。在你最孤独的时刻，我一直陪着你。

source: Do not hate him, my love. His hand was forced by the plodding pace of fate.
target: 不要恨他，我的爱人。命运转动得太慢，才逼得他动了手。

source: How do you want me to kill Hamlet next time, love? Shall we watch him gurgle to death on his own bile and blood? Shall we hang him and watch his face turn blue?
target: 亲爱的，下次你想让我怎么杀哈姆雷特？看着他被自己的胆汁和鲜血呛得咯咯作响，直到死去？还是把他吊起来，看着他的脸变得青紫？

source: Oh, I simply can't wait! We're going to have a lovely time.
target: 哦，我简直等不及了！我们会玩得很愉快的。

source: Last time, our carriage broke down. Lovely detour to Paris we had. And this time, pirates.
target: 上次，我们的马车坏了。结果绕道去了巴黎，玩得很愉快。这次呢，又遇到了海盗。

source: Perhaps even for a short time back then I did love you. But things are different now.
target: 也许当时有那么一小段时间，我确实爱过你。但现在不同了。

source: I'm not certain how she feels. But you know, I think I understand now why you could never love me over her.
target: 我不确定她是什么心意。但你知道吗，我想我现在明白了，为什么你始终更爱她，而不是我。

source: And now I feel strongly about this. Even if Ophelia doesn't return my affections, I love her still.
target: 可如今，我有了这样强烈的感情。即使奥菲莉娅不回应我的爱意，我依然爱她。

source: You don't love her. You love the idea of Ophelia.
target: 你不爱她。你爱的是想象中的奥菲莉娅。

source: Have you ever loved another Danish woman?
target: 你爱过别的丹麦女人吗？

source: What does it matter if I've never loved anyone who looks like Brit?
target: 就算我从没爱过长得像布莉特的人，那又有什么关系？

source: Oh, I know all about it, loves.
target: 哦，亲爱的，这事我全都知道。

source: I'll return you an' your lady-love to Denmark.
target: 我会送你和你的心上人回丹麦。

source: I loved him so much, so damned much, I just—
target: 我那么爱他，爱得要命，我只是——

source: Come here. Let me dry your eyes, love.
target: 过来，亲爱的。让我替你擦干眼泪。

source: I loved him, Irma.
target: 我爱他，伊尔玛。

source: And I love Claudius. I do. But not like him. It's not the same.
target: 我也爱克劳狄斯。真的。但不像爱他那样。那不一样。

source: It will pass. The grief will pass. I have lost half a dozen loves in my lifetime, and this I know for certain. But you must give it time.
target: 会过去的。悲伤会过去的。我这一生失去过六位爱人，所以这一点我很确定。但你得给它一些时间。

source: In fact, I've concocted a lovely plan to out the real spy, if you're so inclined.
target: 事实上，我已经想出了一个揭露真正间谍的妙计，就看你愿不愿意了。

source: My love, for your own sake, you'd better not speak to me again.
target: 亲爱的，为了你自己，你最好别再跟我说话了。

source: What on earth are the people who love you going to do now, Hamlet?
target: 哈姆雷特，爱你的人现在到底该怎么办？

source: I loved you, you bloody idiot. I will always love you.
target: 我爱过你，你这个该死的笨蛋。我会永远爱你。

source: Your stupid cocky smile. Your easily-suffering heart. I've loved a lot of men, but none like you.
target: 你那傻乎乎又自大的笑容。你那颗动不动就受伤的心。我爱过很多男人，却从没像爱你这样爱过谁。

source: Your lack of any and all sense of humor. Damn you. I loved it all, and I wanted you all for myself, body and soul.
target: 还有你那一丁点都没有的幽默感。你这混蛋。你的一切我都爱，我想独占你的全部，你的身体，你的灵魂。

source: He'll never be you. But perhaps I can love him just the same.
target: 他永远不会是你。但也许，我仍能同样爱他。

source: But of all—my best beloved and approved friend, Hortensio; and I trow this is his house.
target: 而其中——我最亲爱、最可信赖的朋友便是霍坦西奥；我想，这就是他的家。

source: Now pray thee, love, stay.
target: 现在，亲爱的，求你留步。

source: If this is your truth, then God will love you for it.
target: 如果这就是真实的你，上帝就会因此爱你。

source: There is another. A Duke's son. He has the love of the people. He would be amenable to your rule.
target: 还有一个人。是一位公爵的儿子。他深受百姓爱戴，也会愿意接受您的统治。

source: He loves her more than anything in this world.
target: 他爱她，胜过这世上的一切。

source: Indeed. It's all up to you, love.
target: 没错。全由你决定，亲爱的。

source: I love you. I want you to live on. I can't imagine a complete life without you.
target: 我爱你。我希望你继续活下去。我无法想象，没有你的人生还能完整。

source: Forty thousand brothers could not, with all their quantity of love, make up my sum—
target: 四万个兄弟的爱加在一起，也抵不过我的爱——

source: Things might seem dark now. But isn't there another way, my love? Surely there must be.
target: 现在也许看不到希望。可是，亲爱的，就没有别的办法了吗？一定还有的。

source: This world requires me to leave the people I love to die by each other's hand, and to take Denmark down with them.
target: 在这个世界里，我得抛下我爱的人，让他们死在彼此手里，把丹麦也一同拖向毁灭。

source: It is tempting to flee responsibility for the lives of those you love.
target: 逃避对所爱之人生命的责任，确实很诱人。

source: I love you, Ophelia.
target: 我爱你，奥菲莉娅。

source: I merely hope your heart is ready for the difficulties which lie ahead of you. Leaving your life behind is no small feat, my love.
target: 我只是希望，你心里已经准备好面对前方的困难。亲爱的，抛下原来的生活可不是件容易的事。

source: But... I love Ophelia. And I know it to be true to the core of everything in me.
target: 但是……我爱奥菲莉娅。我整个人，从内到外，都确信这份爱是真的。

source: Most ordinary folk choose love not knowing where the future might lead.
target: 大多数普通人选择去爱时，都不知道未来会走向何方。

source: If you choose this world, go into it gladly. Do not let the inevitable pain rob the intensity of your love.
target: 如果你选择这个世界，就欣然走进去。别让不可避免的痛苦消磨你炽热的爱意。

source: I want you to find people who love you with all their heart. People who are—good, and whole. Not like me. Not like all of us.
target: 我希望你能找到全心全意爱你的人。那些——善良、内心完整的人。不像我。不像我们这些人。

source: You have a room full of people here who all thought they loved you, of course.
target: 当然，这一屋子的人都曾以为自己爱你。

source: But I'm only realizing this now. To us, love is owning something, breaking it, crushing it as you hold it too tightly.
target: 但我直到现在才明白。对我们来说，爱就是占有，就是把它弄坏，因为抓得太紧而将它捏碎。

source: Please. I've always loved you like my own daughter. Don't abandon me now. You have a responsibility to us, just as we did to you.
target: 求你了。我一直像爱亲生女儿一样爱你。别在这时候抛下我。你对我们有责任，就像我们曾对你有责任一样。

source: Even if it means I'll never see my beloved daughter again.
target: 即使这意味着我再也见不到心爱的女儿。

source: Just know that I have always loved you with everything in my heart, and I would gladly die if it brought you eternal happiness.
target: 你只要知道，我一直全心全意地爱着你。只要能换来你永远的幸福，我就甘愿赴死。

source: Ophelia. Would that I could offer you the embrace of love a father-in-law ought to have for his daughter.
target: 奥菲莉娅。但愿我能给你一个慈爱的拥抱，像公公疼爱儿媳那样。

source: Can you be prepared for that eternity? Can you love him despite that, knowing it has hurt you before?
target: 你能准备好永远面对这一切吗？明知它曾伤害过你，你仍能爱他吗？

source: I fell in love with my master, and he with me. He taught me that love-making, like painting, is an art form unto itself.
target: 我爱上了我的师傅，他也爱上了我。他教会我，做爱和绘画一样，本身就是一门艺术。

source: In Florence, love between men is common. The Germans call a man like me Florenzer. I never thought it strange.
target: 在佛罗伦萨，男人之间相爱是很常见的事。德国人把我这样的男人叫作佛罗伦萨人。我从不觉得这有什么奇怪。

source: Your God is pure, infinite love. A love for humankind which surpasses even the stars. How could he ever hate his own creation?
target: 你们的上帝，是纯粹而无尽的爱。他对人类的爱，甚至超越了群星。他怎么会憎恨自己创造的生命？

source: I did. For my own safety. It was simple: There is only one Dane worth loving at the moment, and he is thoroughly unavailable to me.
target: 是的，为了自己的安全。这很简单：眼下只有一个丹麦人值得我爱，而我和他完全没有可能。

source: You mustn't think of it like some sad, one-sided, pining-away sort of thing, though. I love him in a number of ways.
target: 不过，你可别把这想成什么悲伤的单相思，让人日夜思念、日渐憔悴那种。我对他的爱有很多种。

source: I did. For my own safety. It was simple: There was only ever one Dane worth loving at the moment, and he was thoroughly unavailable to me.
target: 是的，为了自己的安全。这很简单：当时值得我爱的丹麦人始终只有一个，而我和他完全没有可能。

source: You mustn't think of it like some sad, one-sided, pining-away sort of thing, though. I loved him in a number of ways.
target: 不过，你可别把这想成什么悲伤的单相思，独自苦苦思念之类的事。我对他的爱不止一种。

source: I would love to spin you a tale in private, have you the time to listen.
target: 如果您有时间听，我很愿意私下给您讲个故事。

source: The men whispered that she had cursed him. But who were we to say? After all, the captain loved his rum and often drank to uselessness. This time he'd simply gone too far.
target: 船员们私下说，是她诅咒了他。可我们又凭什么断言呢？毕竟，船长嗜好朗姆酒，经常喝得烂醉。这次不过是喝过了头。

source: I would love nothing more. But—as you can see—I've received quite the wound.
target: 我求之不得。可是——你也看到了——我伤得不轻。

source: She told me she loved me and demanded I love her in return. I told her I could not. And she promised never to let me leave until I was hers.
target: 她说她爱我，要求我也爱她。我告诉她，我做不到。她便说，只要我还不属于她，她就绝不会让我离开。

source: Still, I always knew I didn't love her. Sometimes she brought other mortal men and women into her fold. They professed their love to her immediately, and she consumed their hearts.
target: 可我始终知道，我不爱她。有时，她会把别的凡人男女带到她身边。他们立刻向她表白爱意，她便吞食了他们的心。

source: Tell me. Do you... think you've ever been in love, my lady?
target: 告诉我，小姐。你……觉得自己曾经爱上过谁吗？

source: You mean you've never been in love?
target: 你是说，你从来没有爱上过谁？

source: Loving women and having been in love are rather different matters to me.
target: 对我来说，喜欢女人和真正爱上一个人，是很不一样的两回事。

source: Even when you aren't in love anymore, that link still remains. I know he's suffering even now.
target: 就算不再爱那个人了，那份牵绊也还在。我知道，他现在依然很痛苦。

source: Are you... still in love with him, then?
target: 那么，你……还爱着他吗？

source: You can't easily stop loving someone when they're all you've ever known.
target: 如果一个人就是你一直以来熟悉的一切，你很难轻易不再爱他。

source: W-well, the few who have been within the castle walls claim you're the loveliest woman in Claudius's court.
target: 这、这个，有少数进过城堡的人说，你是克劳狄斯宫廷里最美的女人。

source: Then don't come to the palace. Let me show you the gardens, the grounds, the places I love to roam and read.
target: 那就别进宫。我带你看看花园，看看城堡周围的地方，看看我喜欢散步和读书的地方。

source: But if you were to come with me, Ophelia, I'd make you my wife. I'd love you with a ferocity to rival the stars.
target: 但如果你真的跟我走，奥菲莉娅，我会娶你为妻。我对你的爱会炽烈得足以与群星争辉。

source: I'll give that young man one thing: he's true to his word. He'd love you more brightly than the stars.
target: 那个年轻人有一点值得肯定：他说到做到。他对你的爱会比群星更耀眼。

source: But he is fated to love another more powerfully than you. And someday, he'll win her over with songs and stories.
target: 但他命中注定会爱上另一个人，爱得比爱你更深。总有一天，他会用歌声和故事赢得她的心。

source: She will be far unluckier than you. You will lose a love when Othello leaves you. But she will lose her life to him.
target: 她会比你不幸得多。奥赛罗离开你时，你会失去一段爱情。而她会丧命于他手。

source: Ooh, I do so love little puzzles like this!
target: 哦，我真是太喜欢这种小难题了！

source: There are a lot of jilted lovers out there who would pay dearly for this sort of clairvoyance!
target: 有多少被抛弃的恋人，愿意花大价钱换取这样的预知能力啊！

source: My love. My love. We're going to see the world together.
target: 我的爱人。我的爱人。我们要一起去看看这个世界。

source: Find someone who loves you truly and madly, enough to light the stars.
target: 找一个真心而热烈地爱你的人，那份爱足以点亮群星。

source: Come, my love.
target: 来吧，我的爱人。

source: What is it, love?
target: 怎么了，亲爱的？

source: But my love, look at me. Please.
target: 可是，亲爱的，看着我。求你了。

source: You were always going to hurt someone, some day. I watched you even then, and I saw it. Perhaps I could have loved you still, had you been honest with me.
target: 你迟早会伤害别人。那时候我就留意着你，也看出来了。如果你曾对我坦诚，也许我还能继续爱你。

source: My love?
target: 亲爱的？

source: Good. Then the matter is settled. Please take things Ophelia tells you with a skeptical heart, my love.
target: 好。那这件事就到此为止了。亲爱的，奥菲莉娅告诉你的事，请多存几分疑心。

source: Of course, the toys weren't strange to him. For every strange thing is beloved unto someone else.
target: 当然，这些玩具在他看来并不古怪。因为每一样古怪的东西，总会有人喜爱。

source: And the merchant made it his life's endeavor to find an owner who would love every odd thing he ever found.
target: 这位商人毕生追求的，就是为他找到的每一样奇物寻得一个喜爱它的主人。

source: For he so loved bringing together the story threads in pleasing ways. And over the years, he had become quite talented at it—dare he say!
target: 因为他如此喜爱将故事的线索编织在一起，让人赏心悦目。多年下来，他已经十分擅长此道——他敢这么说！

source: Farewell, love. Sweet dreams.
target: 再见，亲爱的。做个好梦。

source: Ophelia, my love, what do you say? Your brother and I desire to leave. What of you?
target: 奥菲莉娅，亲爱的，你怎么说？你哥哥和我都想离开。你呢？

source: A lover? Come now, Laertes. How frivolous of you.
target: 心上人？得了吧，雷欧提斯。你也太轻率了。

source: Apologies, Father. But my mind is made up. I love her.
target: 对不起，父亲。但我已经决定了。我爱她。

source: I'm not certain what the two of you knew—but I loved her.
target: 我不确定你们两人知道多少——但我爱她。

source: And I've loved her ever since she came to Elsinore. I had hoped to leave her safely behind as I went to Paris.
target: 从她来到埃尔西诺起，我就一直爱着她。我原本希望，自己去巴黎时，她能平平安安地留在这里。

source: My love, all the necessary preparations have been made.
target: 亲爱的，一切必要的准备都做好了。

source: Look at me. Don't cry, love.
target: 看着我。别哭，亲爱的。

source: But if we love Hamlet, and want to see him flourish, then...
target: 可如果我们在乎哈姆雷特，希望他过得好，那……

source: I've changed the world to create deaths in the past. Sometimes even deaths of people I loved.
target: 过去，我也曾改变世界，造成过死亡。有时死去的甚至是我爱的人。

source: I love you, sister. No matter what you've become.
target: 我爱你，妹妹。不管你变成了什么。

source: I love you. I love you so much.
target: 我爱你。我真的很爱你。

source: The country would love you for it. Can you imagine? And with my expertise on the throne now, I'd be able to tutor you.
target: 全国都会因此爱戴你。你能想象吗？如今我有了治理国家的经验，也能教导你。

source: I loved my father with all my heart. As did his country. And you took him from all of us.
target: 我全心全意地爱着父亲。他的子民也一样。而你把他从我们所有人身边夺走了。

source: If it's true that you love me no longer, I'll go, and I'll never trouble you again with my affections, nor stumble blindly into your room at dawn.
target: 如果你真的不再爱我，我就离开，再也不会用我的感情来打扰你，也不会再在黎明时莽撞地跌跌撞撞闯进你的房间。

source: The mistakes of our pasts teach us where those whom we love deserve to be.
target: 我们过去犯下的错误，让我们明白所爱的人应当得到怎样的位置。

source: We may come apart, but our trunks rejoin eventually. Even if it's not in love.
target: 我们或许会分开，但树干终究会再次相连。即使不再是因为爱情。

source: But I cannot love you the way you've loved me.
target: 但我无法像你爱我那样爱你。

source: Yes—but you understand people. The way they think. What they love and fear most.
target: 是啊——可你懂人。懂他们怎么想，最爱什么，最怕什么。

source: As Prince, I could marry for love. As King, I must wield marriage as a tool. The marriage I make can improve the world or leave things as they are.
target: 身为王子，我可以为爱结婚。身为国王，我必须把婚姻当作手段。我的婚姻可以让这个世界变得更好，也可以让一切维持原样。

source: But I always believed I'd marry for love. Putting that dream aside will be the hardest of all.
target: 可我一直以为自己会为爱结婚。放下这个梦想，会是最难的一件事。

source: It's a lovely night for a walk, don't you think?
target: 今晚很适合散步，你不觉得吗？

source: Even when we were lovers, I often thought—soon you'll grow bored, or exhausted, or irritated of me at some point.
target: 就算我们还是恋人的时候，我也常想——很快，你总会有一天觉得我无趣，或是累了，或是厌烦我。

source: All this, after you professed to love me.
target: 你口口声声说爱我，之后却有了这一切。

source: I love Ophelia more fiercely than anyone in this world.
target: 我对奥菲莉娅的爱，比这世上任何人都要强烈。

source: I... love Ophelia. I've loved her since we were children.
target: 我……爱奥菲莉娅。从我们还是孩子的时候起，我就一直爱着她。

source: Many of them came to cast dice, play cards, or drink without the watchful eye of their loved ones over them!
target: 他们很多人来这里掷骰子、打牌，或是喝酒，图的就是不用被亲近的人盯着！

source: If you can show them you are sweet if beloved, but vile if spurned, they will avail themselves of you... and see no need to replace you.
target: 如果你能让他们看到，拥戴你时你便和善，拒斥你时你便凶狠，他们就会借助你……也就觉得没必要换掉你了。

source: He's Ophelia's brother. Though I bear him no great love, it would tear her apart to lose him.
target: 他是奥菲莉娅的哥哥。我虽然对他没多少好感，可失去他会让她痛不欲生。

source: Being a King involves making hard decisions. Decisions you know may hurt the ones you love.
target: 做国王就得做出艰难的决定。明知可能伤害自己所爱的人，也得做。

source: Love, I heard you were looking for advice.
target: 亲爱的，听说你在找人给你出主意。

source: My child. My little love. I'm so sorry. Everything that's transpired...
target: 我的孩子。我的小宝贝。我真的很抱歉。发生的这一切……

source: And something familiar. Something beloved.
target: 也有些熟悉的东西。是我深爱的东西。

source: I know. I know you love her. But listen to me.
target: 我知道。我知道你爱她。但听我说。

source: Out of love, I beg you to reconsider asking for Ophelia's hand, and to marry Brit instead.
target: 因为我爱你，所以我恳求你重新考虑向奥菲莉娅求婚的事，改娶布莉特。

source: I love Ophelia.
target: 我爱奥菲莉娅。

source: I love you, Hamlet. Regardless of what I say, I know you'll make a choice all your own, and be the wiser for it.
target: 我爱你，哈姆雷特。不管我说什么，我知道你都会做出自己的选择，并从中变得更明智。

source: I—oh. Ophelia. I wish I knew somethin' kind to say. Was he a good man? Did yeh love him?
target: 我——哦。奥菲莉娅。真希望我能说些什么安慰你。他是个好人吗？你爱他吗？

source: I loved him dearly. But I have faith I'll meet him again.
target: 我很爱他。但我相信，我会再见到他的。

source: But you love him. Or did, once.
target: 可你爱他。或者，曾经爱过。

source: Because I've loved many a man and woman in my life, an' those eyes don't lie.
target: 因为我这辈子爱过不少男人和女人，那样的眼神骗不了人。

source: Always more fun to show someone else th'things you love when they 'aven't done them before.
target: 带别人体验你喜欢的事，总是更有意思，尤其是他们从没做过的时候。

source: Old Donal would be in for a shock, that's for sure. He loved 'is sweet, bonny wife. But that wife is gone. The Pirate Queen took 'er place.
target: 老多纳尔肯定会大吃一惊。他爱的是那个温柔漂亮的妻子。可那个妻子已经不在了，取而代之的是海盗女王。

source: She always knew you loved her regardless.
target: 她一直都知道，不管怎样，你都是爱她的。

source: But Guilda--pranks aside, your funeral was attended by those who truly love you. Isn't that enough?
target: 可是吉尔达——撇开恶作剧不说，来参加你葬礼的都是真心爱你的人。这还不够吗？

source: Love me? Love is overrated. I want fame! I want entire harems full of fanatic admirers!
target: 爱我？爱被捧得太高了。我要名气！我要一座座后宫，里面全是狂热的仰慕者！

source: I'd love to. Let me gather my things and I'll come with you.
target: 我很愿意。等我收拾好东西，就跟你们一起走。

source: Of course. Perdita. You are lovelier than I ever thought possible.
target: 当然。潘狄塔。你比我能想象的还要美丽。

source: Everything is lovely in the springtime.
target: 春日里，一切都那么美好。

source: ...He would be if you were dead. Everyone sees the love your brother has for you. It's unparalleled.
target: ……如果你死了，他就会变成那样。所有人都看得出你哥哥有多爱你。无人能及。

source: But she-- I-- we loved each other.
target: 可她——我——我们曾经相爱。

source: The only person who ever deemed me worthy of love.
target: 她是唯一一个觉得我值得被爱的人。

source: She had this infinite capacity to love, and to love him, and me, no matter what we did, or how sad she was to be trapped in a foreign land...
target: 她心里的爱无穷无尽。无论我们做了什么，无论困在异国他乡让她有多难过，她都能爱着他，也爱着我……

source: I'm sorry, my lord. It's clear to me how deeply you loved her.
target: 我很遗憾，陛下。我看得出来，您爱她爱得很深。

source: It is the hope of all that they might find a love like that someday.
target: 每个人都希望，有一天自己也能找到这样的爱情。

source: I've tried to love other women before, women who weren't her, but I couldn't.
target: 我以前也试着去爱别的女人，去爱她以外的人，但我做不到。

source: M-maybe there's a world where I could love you.
target: 也、也许有一个世界，我能爱上你。

source: Not the way I loved her. But different.
target: 不像我爱她那样。会是另一种爱。

source: Drat this old, moldy castle. My father had such a love for it.
target: 这座又老又发霉的城堡，真烦人。我父亲却那么喜欢它。

source: In the last year especially, you have grown lovelier than ever before.
target: 尤其是过去这一年，你出落得比以往任何时候都美。

source: I was always urged to take additional lovers, as all men in my position are.
target: 总有人劝我再找些情人，像我这个身份的男人，都会受到这种劝说。

source: I loved Gertrude. And only Gertrude. But now I am forced to contend with the possibility that, in her absence, I am only human.
target: 我爱乔特鲁德。只爱乔特鲁德。可现在，我不得不面对一种可能：她不在了，我也终究只是个凡人。

source: Even then I realized the truth. There are no good men. We women see the wickedness in their hearts. And we ignore it out of love.
target: 那时我就已经明白了真相。没有哪个男人是好人。我们女人看得见他们心里的邪恶，却因为爱而选择无视。

source: My love, no one man or woman can stop a vengeful king. It takes a proper coup.
target: 亲爱的，无论男女，谁都无法独自阻止一个一心复仇的国王。那需要一场真正的政变。

source: What calls you to me, love?
target: 亲爱的，什么事让你来找我？

source: It's her former lover. He's gone stark raving mad.
target: 是她以前的情人。他彻底疯了。

source: ...Is that he's in love with someone else.
target: ……就是他爱上了别人。

source: Othello, what would you do if someone you loved found a new love of their own?
target: 奥赛罗，要是你爱的人另有新欢，你会怎么办？

source: Me? Well, to be certain, I've never loved all that deeply.
target: 我？嗯，说实在的，我从没爱得那么深过。

source: If you love that person, then you love the very act of them loving, because it brings them great happiness.
target: 如果你爱那个人，就也会爱那个人去爱别人这件事，因为那能带来莫大的幸福。

source: And if the target of their love isn't you... then you must relinquish your feelings for the sake of their happiness.
target: 而如果那个人爱的不是你……你就必须为了那个人的幸福，放下自己的感情。

source: Find someone new to love.
target: 找个新的心上人吧。

source: To new love!
target: 为新的爱情干杯！

source: To forgetting old love!
target: 为忘掉旧爱干杯！

source: My spring, my joy, my day, my beloved, my laughing rose...
target: 我的春天，我的欢喜，我的白昼，我的挚爱，我含笑的玫瑰……

source: And I do so love to be serenaded. Especially by the strong, silent type.
target: 而且我最喜欢有人为我唱情歌了。尤其是强壮又沉默寡言的那种。

source: 'Now she doesn't love you, but soon her heart will burn...'
target: ‘她如今不爱你，不久便会心燃爱火……’

source: Yeah! Shame on you! Our love is not for sale!
target: 就是！你们要不要脸！我们的爱不卖！

source: She's got a lovely sound.
target: 这琴的声音真好听。

source: You understand the great love I bear for you and your family, Laertes. Always have. Always will.
target: 雷欧提斯，你知道我对你和你的家人有多深的感情。过去如此，将来也如此。

source: It continues, 'Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you.'
target: 后面还说，‘要爱你们的仇敌，祝福那诅咒你们的人，善待那恨你们的人。’

source: Because of the love you bear for my wife, I should hope.
target: 我希望，是出于你对我妻子的敬爱。

source: Horatio, you ought to know me better than that. How many of my lady loves did you meet at Wittenberg?
target: 霍拉旭，你应该更了解我才对。在威登堡，你见过多少位我的女情人？

source: Fine. If you must hear it, let me say it, then. I came to love Hamlet.
target: 好吧。如果你非要听，那我就说。我爱上了哈姆雷特。

source: I've been in love with you for a long time, Hamlet.
target: 我爱你很久了，哈姆雷特。

source: I know what it's like to love someone who doesn't care for you.
target: 我知道爱上一个不爱自己的人是什么滋味。

source: I am far too old to agonize over unrequited love. Lingering disappointment, on the other hand, is not beyond me.
target: 我早过了为单恋痛不欲生的年纪。不过，久久挥之不去的失望，我还是会有的。

source: I do love you in a way. But it isn't like that, and it never will be.
target: 某种意义上，我确实爱你。但不是那种爱，也永远不会是。

source: I will always be your most ardent and faithful friend. But when it comes to matters of love, that's different.
target: 我永远都会是你最热忱、最忠诚的朋友。但爱情是另一回事。

source: If ever you did love me, if ever you did find me worthy of your time... then you will join me here in the quiet of oblivion, and take up an eternal rest.
target: 如果你曾真心在乎我，如果你曾觉得我值得你花时间……那就与我一同留在这里，在虚无的寂静中永远安息吧。

source: Hamlet and I were together for two years, in secret. In that time, he was... different. Happier. He had a sense of humor then. Neither of us had ever loved another before, but he treated me with respect and an unfailing kindness.
target: 我和哈姆雷特曾秘密交往了两年。那时，他……很不一样。更快乐。那时候他还很有幽默感。我们此前都没有爱过别人，但他尊重我，始终温柔地待我。

source: Father goes to visit Mother's grave often. He still mourns her all the time. He tells me she'd be proud of the person I became. I hope that's true. I don't remember her, so all I know of her is what Father and Laertes tell me. Can you love someone you don't remember?
target: 父亲常去母亲的墓前。他仍然无时无刻不在怀念她。他告诉我，她会为如今的我感到骄傲。我希望这是真的。我不记得她，所以关于她的一切，都来自父亲和雷欧提斯的讲述。一个人能爱自己不记得的人吗？

source: We'll fight him head-on. He's an impetuous young boy—no more threat than a gadfly to our throne, my love.
target: 我们就正面迎战。他不过是个鲁莽的毛头小子——亲爱的，他对我们王位的威胁，也就和一只牛虻差不多。

source: With my lovely Queen by my side, we will be a force far beyond anything the northern lands have seen before!
target: 有我美丽的王后陪伴在侧，我们的力量将远远超越北方诸国以往所见！

source: Ophelia! There you are, love.
target: 奥菲莉娅！原来你在这儿，亲爱的。

source: I know you loved him once. I'm your father. I see these things.
target: 我知道你曾经爱过他。我是你父亲，这些事我看得出来。

source: Father gave her... anything. Everything. I've never seen a love like it. I've never loved like it.
target: 父亲给了她……她想要的一切。他的一切。我从没见过那样的爱。我也从没那样爱过。

source: Do you remember my father, Lord? How much he... loved her?
target: 主啊，你还记得我父亲吗？记得他有多么……爱她吗？

source: He gave her anything. Everything. I've never seen a love like it. I've never loved like it.
target: 她想要什么，他就给什么。他把一切都给了她。我从没见过那样的爱。我也从没那样爱过。

source: The last time we fought, you were clear about holding no love in your heart for me.
target: 上次我们吵架时，你说得很清楚，你心里没有对我的爱。

source: Well, that's not strange, is it? That's how he always is with you lately. A lovesick idiot, like a dog that comes crawling back even after it's been kicked.
target: 那也不奇怪吧？最近他在你面前不一直这样吗？一个为情所困的傻瓜，像条挨了踢还要爬回来的狗。

source: About Hamlet's late-night visit... He wasn't exactly professing his love to me.
target: 关于哈姆雷特深夜来找我的事……他并不是在向我表白。

source: No, perhaps it matters not. Surely, love plays some part in his madness...
target: 不，也许这并不重要。他的疯癫，肯定也有几分是因为爱情……

source: Lovely. Well, if you're of no help, I'll be on my way.
target: 真好。那么，如果你帮不上忙，我就告辞了。

source: At your funeral, two men jump into the grave and fight over who loves you the most.
target: 在你的葬礼上，两个男人跳进墓穴，为谁更爱你而打了起来。

source: Love. You're worrying me.
target: 宝贝。你这样让我很担心。

source: Oh! I love a good thriller. I'll play your sidekick.
target: 哦！我最喜欢精彩的惊险故事了。我来当你的助手。

source: And if one loves a good story, one must adopt a certain level of patience. The good ones are... slow burns.
target: 如果一个人喜欢好故事，就必须有些耐心。好故事总是……慢慢酝酿的。

source: I love you, dearest. Get some rest.
target: 我爱你，亲爱的。去休息一下吧。

source: Over time that comfort grew to familiarity, then to affection, then to love. I witnessed it and I did not stop it.
target: 渐渐地，那份安慰变成了亲近，继而是好感，最后成了爱情。我看在眼里，却没有阻止。

source: Even if that weren't wildly inappropriate, love, I haven't got a key.
target: 亲爱的，就算这事不是那么失礼，我也没有钥匙。

source: Quite a love match, that one.
target: 他们俩还真是情投意合啊。

source: We're going to have a lovely private little evening, he and I.
target: 他和我会单独度过一个美好的夜晚。

source: I love moonlight walks! Almost as much as I love my dearest lady-in-waiting exploiting my son's weakened emotional state.
target: 我最喜欢月下散步了！喜欢的程度，几乎赶得上我最亲爱的宫廷侍女利用我儿子脆弱的心境。

source: King Hamlet loved her with the fondness of ten men. And she betrayed him.
target: 哈姆雷特国王对她的爱，比得上十个男人的深情。可她却背叛了他。

source: I had expected that one day someone I love would approach me and say this very thing.
target: 我早料到，总有一天，我所珍视的人会走到我面前，说出这番话。

source: If there is any love in your heart, you will not unveil me to them, Ophelia. I beg this of you. Please.
target: 奥菲莉娅，如果你还顾念一点情分，就不要向他们揭露我的秘密。我恳求你。求你了。

source: I've found proof that the Queen was dishonest with her husband before his death, and loved King Claudius.
target: 我找到了证据，证明王后在丈夫去世之前就欺骗了他，爱上了克劳狄斯国王。

source: Come now, love. Where did you hear a thing like that?
target: 好了，亲爱的。你从哪儿听来这种话的？

source: She has far more patience and love for you than I.
target: 她对你可比我有耐心得多，也疼爱得多。

source: I loved him too. I loved him dearly. And I will never forget the kindness he showed me.
target: 我也爱他。我很爱他。我永远不会忘记他对我的好。

source: Ahh, a daughter's love. Such a tender little thing.
target: 啊，女儿的爱。多么柔软的小东西。

source: You must come to love her as the Queen does. Do not try to overpower her. You are both strong, but not dissimilar...
target: 你得学着像王后一样喜爱她。别试着压过她。你们都很坚强，也并非那么不同……

source: Do keep this information moving towards the brawny arms of justice. I so love a good procedural drama.
target: 请继续把这条消息送向正义那强壮的臂膀。我可太喜欢精彩的探案剧了。

source: Heard? Why, love, I invited him myself.
target: 听说？亲爱的，可是我亲自邀请他来的。

source: Love. Hamlet is gone.
target: 亲爱的。哈姆雷特已经不在了。

source: Better leave these matters to the men who order the troops, my love. The issue is being handled.
target: 亲爱的，这些事还是留给指挥军队的男人们吧。这件事已经有人在处理了。

source: Careful about that, love.
target: 可得当心，亲爱的。

source: Well, love, if it'll put your mind at ease, I'll call a small council.
target: 好吧，亲爱的，如果这样能让你安心，我就召集一场小规模的会议。

source: Of course, they might also be soggy love poems. Harmless and simple.
target: 当然，也可能只是些缠绵腻人的情诗。简单又无害。

source: He loved reading. Do you expect I tracked every tome in his library?
target: 他喜欢读书。难道你以为，他书房里的每一本书我都留意过？

source: I bring quilts, clothing for babes. I am merely an old woman who wishes to love God and enjoy the joyful silence of a life well lived.
target: 我带来的是被子和婴儿衣服。我只是个老太婆，只想敬爱上帝，享受这一生过得充实所带来的欢喜与安宁。

source: He knows I loved your mother like my own flesh and blood. Very well, then. May this be my final gift to her.
target: 他知道，我爱你的母亲，就像爱自己的骨肉一样。那好吧。愿这是我送给她的最后一份礼物。

source: Only love can dispel such a thing. And even then, it may take many years. Or he may never change at all.
target: 只有爱能驱散这一切。即便如此，也可能需要很多年。也可能他永远都不会改变。

source: My father loved her deeply, in the time they were wedded. Then he, too, died, and it was just my brother Hamlet and I, stuck with one another.
target: 他们婚姻存续期间，我父亲深爱着她。后来他也死了，就只剩下我和哥哥哈姆雷特，不得不与彼此相伴。

source: It matters not. My father loved her, at least in front of the court, and I remember her very little.
target: 这不重要。我的父亲爱她，至少在宫廷众人面前是如此，而我对她的记忆已经很少了。

source: And she died, in pain, alone, far away from anyone she loved.
target: 于是，她独自一人，忍着痛苦死去了。她所爱的人，没有一个在她身边。

source: Help me keep the people I love alive. That's how you can make this right.
target: 帮我保住我爱的那些人的性命。这样你才能弥补这一切。

source: But long after they've given in to madness, or lovesickness, or fainting over themselves, you and I will still be here fighting.
target: 可等他们早已陷入疯狂、相思，或是顾影自怜到昏厥时，你我还会在这里抗争。

source: I'm sorry to hear about your mother. You are living proof that there can be a better way, Ophelia. You're loved by all.
target: 听到你母亲的事，我很难过。奥菲莉娅，你就是活生生的证明，证明事情可以变得更好。大家都很喜欢你。

source: ...If I am loved, it is only for my father's blood.
target: ……如果有人喜欢我，那也只是因为我身上流着父亲的血。

source: Oh, I love this game. Are we telling tall tales? How fun!
target: 哦，我喜欢这个游戏。我们是在编离奇故事吗？真有意思！

source: Oh, my love—if you're worried, we'll have the guards watch after him more closely.
target: 哦，亲爱的——如果你担心，我们就让卫兵把他盯得紧些。

source: Is everything all right, love? You've begun to sound an awful lot like... well...
target: 亲爱的，你没事吧？你说起话来越来越像……实在太像……唉……

source: You don' know 'em? All the guards collect 'em in the forest. Then they make pies. We love 'em!
target: 你不知道那是什么？卫兵们都去林子里采，再拿来做派。我们可爱吃了！

source: Love, please don't tell anyone about what you saw. Please. It could mean my head.
target: 亲爱的，请别把你看到的事告诉任何人。求你了。这可能会让我掉脑袋。

source: I don't know what you mean, my love. Don't worry your head over it.
target: 我不知道你在说什么，亲爱的。别为这事费心了。

source: Charming... but I don't answer to you any more, love.
target: 真讨人喜欢……可我已经不归你管了，亲爱的。

source: Suggesting he would harm you feels inordinately strong, love. However...
target: 亲爱的，说他会伤害你，似乎有些言过其实。不过……

source: And then she falls in love with her super cute canoness. Such a great series.
target: 然后她爱上了她那位超级可爱的女教士。这系列真是太棒了。

source: She lied to us, Ophelia. And most of all, she lied to me. I loved her, and she looked into my eyes and she told me falsehoods.
target: 她骗了我们，奥菲莉娅。尤其是，她骗了我。我爱她，她却看着我的眼睛，对我说谎。

source: It's always, 'how is your health?' Or 'isn't it lovely outside?' And never, 'what makes you truly happy?' or 'what was your mother like?'
target: 总是问“你身体好吗？”或者“外面天气真好，是吧？”从来不问“什么能让你真正快乐？”或是“你母亲是个什么样的人？”

source: Because you love him.
target: 因为你爱他。

source: Even before King Hamlet's passing, Claudius and Gertrude were lovers. Gertrude herself wrote about it in her diary.
target: 在哈姆雷特国王去世之前，克劳狄斯和乔特鲁德就已经是情人。乔特鲁德亲自在日记里写下了这件事。

source: She died before I can even remember. I know Father loved her a lot.
target: 我还没记事，她就去世了。我知道父亲很爱她。

source: They say love is that sort of thing. A shared delusion. I wouldn't know. I've never been in love.
target: 人们说，爱情就是这样——两个人共同的妄想。我也不懂。我从没爱上过谁。

source: Don't say that, my love. My faults and my actions are my own. It is by my hand that I am here.
target: 别这么说，亲爱的。我的过错和所作所为，都该由我自己负责。是我亲手让自己落到了这里。

source: Hamlet is lovesick
target: 哈姆雷特为情所苦

source: Othello and Ophelia are lovers
target: 奥赛罗和奥菲莉娅是恋人

source: Claudius and Ophelia are lovers
target: 克劳狄斯和奥菲莉娅是恋人

source: Laertes and Brit are lovers
target: 雷欧提斯和布莉特是恋人

source: And I know that someday soon, you two will come to love each other as dearly as I love her.
target: 我知道，用不了多久，你们之间的感情也会像我对她的感情一样深厚。

source: I have reacted with dislike towards him in the past. But now all that must change. Let us build a new love, he and I.
target: 过去，我对他总是心怀反感。但现在，这一切都必须改变。就让他和我重新建立感情吧。

source: There is so little time in this world to show the ones we love how deeply we prize them.
target: 我们在世上的时间太短，能让所爱的人知道我们有多珍惜他们的机会太少。

source: You know, they might not have loved one another deeply, but... in the end, Claudius came to kiss him goodbye.
target: 你知道，他们之间的感情也许并不深厚，但……最后，克劳狄斯还是来吻了他，向他告别。

source: He needs all the love I can shower on him. I'll try my best to rouse his spirits.
target: 他需要我倾尽所有的关爱。我会尽力让他振作起来。

source: Over time that comfort grew to familiarity, then to affection, then to love. I witnessed it and I did not stop it.
target: 渐渐地，那份安慰变成了亲近，继而是好感，最后成了爱情。我看在眼里，却没有阻止。

source: It matters not. My father loved her, at least in front of the court, and I remember her very little.
target: 这不重要。我的父亲爱她，至少在宫廷众人面前是如此，而我对她的记忆已经很少了。

source: Be careful, love. That's all I ask. Carrying on like this—it terrifies me. I don't want you hurt.
target: 要小心，亲爱的。我只求你这一点。你一直这样下去——我真的很害怕。我不想你受伤。

source: My notes—my notes, taken by him, out of love, out of protection—
target: 我的笔记——我的笔记，他拿走了，出于关切，出于保护——

source: But Guilda—pranks aside, your funeral was attended by those who truly love you. Isn't that enough?
target: 可是吉尔达——撇开恶作剧不说，来参加你葬礼的都是真心爱你的人。这还不够吗？

source: If ever you did love me, if ever you did find me worthy of your time... then you will join me here in the quiet of oblivion, and take up an eternal rest.
target: 如果你曾真心在乎我，如果你曾觉得我值得你花时间……那就与我一同留在这里，在虚无的寂静中永远安息吧。

source: Don't weep, my love. I have heard your prayers and whispers. I was with you in your loneliest moments.
target: 别哭，我的爱人。我听见了你的祈祷和低语。在你最孤独的时刻，我一直陪着你。

source: Do not hate him, my love. His hand was forced by the plodding pace of fate.
target: 不要恨他，我的爱人。命运转动得太慢，才逼得他动了手。

source: Most ordinary folk choose love not knowing where the future might lead.
target: 大多数普通人选择去爱时，都不知道未来会走向何方。

source: If you choose this world, go into it gladly. Do not let the inevitable pain rob the intensity of your love.
target: 如果你选择这个世界，就欣然走进去。别让不可避免的痛苦消磨你炽热的爱意。

source: Ophelia. Would that I could offer you the embrace of love a father-in-law ought to have for his daughter.
target: 奥菲莉娅。但愿我能给你一个慈爱的拥抱，像公公疼爱儿媳那样。

source: Can you be prepared for that eternity? Can you love him despite that, knowing it has hurt you before?
target: 你能准备好永远面对这一切吗？明知它曾伤害过你，你仍能爱他吗？

source: It is tempting to flee responsibility for the lives of those you love.
target: 逃避对所爱之人生命的责任，确实很诱人。

source: But she—I—we loved each other.
target: 可她——我——我们曾经相爱。

source: Hello, love. What would you like to discuss?
target: 你好，亲爱的。你想聊什么？

source:
Irma is one of the most feared women in Elsinore for her quick temper. She's fiercely devoted to the Queen, and originally followed Gertrude from Bohemia, where she and Gertrude were both born and raised.

 Despite her teeth, I've seen that she has a warm side. She loves to gamble, and she's quite good; I wouldn't make a bet against her for all the world.
target:
伊尔玛脾气急躁，是埃尔西诺最让人畏惧的女人之一。她对王后忠心耿耿，当年从波希米亚随乔特鲁德来到这里。她和乔特鲁德都在那里出生、长大。

虽然她很厉害，我也见过她温暖的一面。她喜欢赌博，而且很有一手；说什么我也不会跟她对赌。

source: Hamlet's madness was brought on not by love, but by a meeting with what he believes to be the spirit of his father. It's from there he must have gotten his information about Claudius's murder. But the information turned out to be correct—so does this spirit actually exist?
